rule.statement: The provisions of the Act have no application to the premises at issue if the premises is not a 'Low Cost House'.
rule.supporting_quote: It is evident from the document P5 that the premises in issue had been allocated to the Petitioner as an 'Official Quarters' and there is nothing to indicate that house is a Low- cost house. P5 lays down a number of conditions and one of them is that, if the house is in need of repairs, the petitioner was required to give a month’s notice to the Special Commissioner, Anuradhapura.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Local Authorities Housing Act No.14 of 1964 as amended
